title: LearnOps LTI launch result (B3, v1)
description: The normalised result of a successful LTI 1.3 launch, as produced by libs/lti and read by the modules (PRD B3). It is NOT the incoming ID token and NOT the raw Moodle claims. It exists only after the launch has been fully validated and a baseline role has been resolved; launches that fail validation, have no recognised role, are Learner-only, or lack a course context are refused before any result is produced.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced here: signature, exp, aud, azp, iss, deployment_id (against the configured registration), nonce single use and state checks (PRD SEC-01); role-URI mapping and precedence; session binding, expiry and course isolation. Those are enforced by libs/lti and its tests (see lti-launch.v1.md). The role enum is limited to the baseline tools (Mentor and Administrator) because Learner launches are refused before a baseline session exists (PRD B3, EXT-07). Raw ID tokens, nonces and key material must never appear in this document.

iss.description: Issuer of the launch: the identifier of the Moodle platform. Together with sub and context.id it forms the session identity, and together with context.id it is the key of shared.course_link.

sub.description: Stable identifier of the user, assigned by the platform issuer in iss. Unique only within one issuer.

deployment_id.description: Deployment identifier of the launch. It has already been checked against the configured registration; it is carried so modules can log and audit it.

message_type.description: The LTI message type. Only LtiResourceLinkRequest is accepted in v1; Deep Linking is not required.

role.description: The one normalised role for this launch. mentor comes from the Instructor role URI; administrator comes from the institution Administrator role URI and takes precedence when both are present. Learner is not a value in v1 because baseline tools refuse Learner launches (EXT-07).

context.description: The course the user launched from. A user sees only data for this context, except administrators (PRD A5).

id.$comment: A positive integer in ASCII digits: no sign, no leading zero, no padding, no other character. The (?!\n) lookahead is deliberate: in Python's re, $ also matches before a final newline, so '42\n' would pass a plain ^[1-9][0-9]*$. No upper bound is set on purpose. The pattern also rules out the empty string.
id.description: LTI context id. Moodle supplies its course id here (ADR 0011 section 13), so it is a positive integer written as a string. Zero, negative, non-numeric, leading-zero, whitespace-padded, non-ASCII-digit and newline-containing values are rejected.

title.description: Course title as sent by the platform. Optional; for display only.

resource_link.description: The tool placement in the course that was launched.

id.description: Resource link id of the launched placement.

name.description: Display name if the platform shared it, otherwise null. Optional (PRD SEC-06).

email.description: Email address if the platform shared it, otherwise null. Optional (PRD SEC-06).
